entities.summary: Yitzhak Shimon Wasserlauf is an Israeli politician who has served as the Minister for the Development of the Periphery, the Negev, and the Galilee since 2025, and currently serves as a member of Knesset for Otzma Yehudit, following the 2022 Israeli legislative election.
